fidelity_audit_source: independent annotator over the same recordings; agreement and error estimated per HWP-13
missing_data_behavior: refuse the trial as unscorable; never default to success
observation_window: goal receipt to timeout_s or verdict
output_schema: episode_result with status, failure, t_end, goal_id, verifier=physical
success_rule: target object resting inside the tray region for 2 s within the observation window, judged from recorded overhead RGB-D
wrong_object_rule: any non-target object entering the tray region as detected by the frozen label reader on recorded frames
